verse.verse_1: Woe to those that deal in fraud,-
verse.verse_2: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure,
verse.verse_3: But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.
verse.verse_4: Do they not think that they will be called to account?-
verse.verse_6: A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
verse.verse_7: Nay! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin.
verse.verse_8: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is?
verse.verse_10: Woe, that Day, to those that deny-
verse.verse_11: Those that deny the Day of Judgment.
verse.verse_12: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner!
verse.verse_13: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients!"
verse.verse_14: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do!
verse.verse_15: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled.
verse.verse_16: Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell.
verse.verse_17: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false!
verse.verse_18: Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin.
verse.verse_19: And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is?
verse.verse_21: To which bear witness those Nearest (to Allah).
verse.verse_22: Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss:
verse.verse_23: On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things):
verse.verse_24: Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss.
verse.verse_25: Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed:
verse.verse_26: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations:
verse.verse_27: With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim:
verse.verse_28: A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to Allah.
verse.verse_29: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed,
verse.verse_30: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery);
verse.verse_31: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;
verse.verse_32: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray!"
verse.verse_33: But they had not been sent as keepers over them!
verse.verse_34: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers:
verse.verse_35: On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things).
verse.verse_36: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did?
